case_number: 2024 INSC 397; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2024 [Arising out of SLP (C) No(s). 28466 of 2023]
summary: Child custody dispute between military father and teacher mother; High Court overturned Family Court's sole custody award; appellate jurisdiction under Family Courts Act examined; children's welfare paramount; shared custody ordered with rotational arrangements based on academic calendar and posting; expenses allocation per travel direction; child preferences considered; appeal allowed in part with modified shared custody framework; jurisdictional challenges rejected.
legal_provisions_cited: Guardian and Wards Act, 1890 s.7, s.9, s.25
Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 s.12
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; High Court's shared custody arrangement modified; parental responsibilities clarified; expenses allocation defined; rotational custody schedule confirmed based on children's residence location.
